fichas.title: Conversion of an Office Building to Flats
fichas.summary: An office building was converted to flats by extending its main wing toward the garden and introducing new slabs and a new load-bearing structure to allow varied floor layouts. The existing hollow-pot floor was replaced with a reinforced-concrete slab on thermally insulating bearings at the external wall to help avoid cold bridging. The text notes that conversions require upgrading for sound, thermal, and fire insulation, and that structural strengthening can substantially reduce clear ceiling height.

fichas.title: Conversion of a Factory to Flats
fichas.summary: A listed factory hall was converted to flats. A greened internal courtyard with gallery access splits the building depth. A special exemption allowed ceiling heights below the normal minimum in some rooms, with the height reduction applied to less important rooms of the maisonettes.
